title: UnitedHealth Group: Beyond The Premium - [Business Breakdowns, EP.219]
summary:
At a recent apex, UNH was a half trillion dollar market cap business, the 15th largest listed business in the United States. We'll explore how United Health Care operates as a fully integrated health care system from its insurance arm,
United Health Care, its namesake, to its high-margin health services business, Optum. We'll provide a breakdown of the unique and often inefficient US health care ecosystem that United Health navigates,
and how the company is built a powerful flywheel to drive growth and address system
